edges.label: Contractor records are outside the statute
edges.note: FOIA reaches agency records; material moved into contractor custody leaves the statute's reach without any change in classification. Reasoning stated in the d-foia dossier.

edges.label: The seam between government and industry
edges.note: FAR 35.017 gives the FFRDC access to both government classified holdings and contractor proprietary data - the only entity type that can see both sides of the compartment.
